notes.title: Update October 24
notes.content: In this small update, we have added the ability to reset progress. If you suddenly want to start from scratch, then by going to the main menu you can press a special button and reset progress.

notes.title: What will change with the release of the game from early access?
notes.content:
Removing the Simulator from Early Access  
We are actively working on the update and will soon take the game out of early access.

In the upcoming release of the simulator from early access, we have added a lot of interesting things that give a new gaming experience.

 You will now be able to:
[olist]
Buying a house.
Buying cars. 
Complete certain tasks to complete our simulator.
Much more.
[/olist]

In this post, we want to pay attention to the purchase of cars in our simulator. At the moment, we have 6 cars available. Let's go through each of them in more detail. (The prices listed below may differ from those in the game.)

Coin
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45153060/65c16e93dd7c3beb3d9f9e8d3938f219d2f6bc4e.png
One of the first cars you can buy. It is inexpensive, about 100.000$. A simple and easy way to get around.

Bread roll
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45153060/90d44ee3b83f95b7f1cf9c5bf76e76ef35c626ae.png
This is already a more serious option for getting around the city. It costs 200.000$. It is worth buying, as it gives a slightly unusual atmosphere when moving around.

Busik
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45153060/6468423c206167652afb3d5dbff6fd281c35bdf6.png
If you wanted to sit behind the wheel of a bus, then now you have the opportunity to do it. Buy Busik  for  $ 250,000  and drive around the expanses of the island.

Sportik 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45153060/a0353309c577e74ec59c1cc7b7021ff3c03d7b9a.png
So what? It's time to switch to sports cars. Once your pick-up point makes a good profit, you can buy a fancy sports car for$500,000.

Komarik
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45153060/f7eeac23aa91c347d7aaf83235e160dae55cf304.png
And finally, the dream of our pick-up point manager, the coolest and most fashionable sports car for a whole $ 1,000,000. In order to buy it, you will need a lot of effort and diligence. So hold on!

At the moment, this is all the transport that is available for purchase. If you have any suggestions, we are happy to see them in the comments. Good luck to all!
